c1-jas-0008: Two visitors walk in, and one looks fancy. Peek at James 2:2.
c2-jas-0002: James talks about making big plans. James 4:14 tells what life is like.
c2-jas-0003: Where would the poor visitor be told to go? Read James 2:3 and 4.
c2-jas-0004: Workers were cheated of their pay. Somebody heard them. See James 5:3 and 4.
c3-jas-0001: Is someone sick? James gives a plan in James 5:13 and 14.
c3-jas-0002: God sees the poor in a special way. Look at James 2:5 and 5:1.
c3-jas-0003: Draw near to God, friend. Then check James 4:8 and 5:16.
c3-jas-0004: Keeping God's law takes all of us. Dig into James 2:10 and 4:17.
c1-1pe-0002: The Chief Shepherd is coming back. First Peter 5:4 tells the reward.
c2-1pe-0006: Peter says to open your home to others. Read First Peter 4:9.
c2-1pe-0007: Nobody should suffer for doing wrong. Turn to First Peter 4:15 and 16.
c2-1pe-0008: Peter tells leaders how to care for God's flock. See First Peter 5:2 and 3.
c3-1pe-0003: Doing good can quiet some folks down. Find out in First Peter 2:14 and 15.
c3-1pe-0004: God gives each of us a gift to share. Read First Peter 2:16 and 4:10.
c3-1pe-0005: People notice how we live. Look at First Peter 2:12 and 3:16.
c3-1pe-0006: Who could hurt you? Peter asks in First Peter 3:13 and 5:3.
c1-1jn-0002: John tells his dear friends what time it is. Read First John 2:18.
c2-1jn-0006: God's anointing stays with His people. First John 2:27 says more.
c2-1jn-0007: Some folks left the group. John explains in First John 2:19 and 26.
c2-1jn-0008: What if our heart doesn't blame us? See First John 3:20 and 21.
c3-1jn-0003: A brother is in need. What then? Read First John 3:16 and 17.
c3-1jn-0004: Jesus came with a big job to do. Check First John 2:1 and 3:8.
c3-1jn-0005: John cheers on God's people. Turn to First John 2:22 and 4:4.
c3-1jn-0006: God's Spirit lives in His people. Look at First John 3:24 and 4:6.
c1-eph-0007: Paul says not to make the Spirit sad. Read Ephesians 4:30.
c2-eph-0001: Paul tells the Ephesians how to live. Ephesians 5:1 tells what to be.
c2-eph-0002: Paul says to tell the truth to your neighbor. See Ephesians 4:25 and 26.
c2-eph-0003: Don't let anyone fool you, says Paul. Read Ephesians 5:6 and 7.
c3-eph-0002: Paul loves to hear God's people sing. Turn to Ephesians 5:19 and 20.
c3-eph-0003: Christ gave Himself up out of love. Look at Ephesians 5:2 and 25.
c3-eph-0004: Christ will make His church glorious. Dig into Ephesians 4:24 and 5:27.
c3-eph-0005: Paul lists things to put away. Find them in Ephesians 4:31 and 6:4.
c1-jud-0001: Jude tells who he is. Me? I keep my past a mystery. Jude 1:1.
c2-jud-0001: Jude tells about Enoch, a man from long ago. Read Jude 1:14.
c2-jud-0002: Jude warns about some men who went the wrong way. See Jude 1:11 and 16.
c2-jud-0003: Mockers would come someday, Jude says. Check Jude 1:18 and 19.
c3-jud-0001: Jude says this was told ahead of time. Look at Jude 1:17 and 18.
c3-jud-0002: Jude says keep yourselves and look for mercy. Read Jude 1:21 and 24.
c3-jud-0003: The Lord is coming with His saints. Turn to Jude 1:3 and 15.
c3-jud-0004: Jude prays for mercy, peace, and love. Dig into Jude 1:2 and 20.
